dogecoin.text:
I have never owned #Dogecoin as it never made logical sense to me. 

There is value in the community but the yearly 5 billion coin inflation coupled with the limited use for tipping does not seem compelling enough. 

Either my logic is wrong or we are due for a big correction!

% of #crypto users who own altcoins: 

Jan 2021: 20%
June 2021: 38%

This is clearly the #dogecoin effect. 

You can read my analysis and summary here: https://t.co/7aEsYuFiUb
